name: Restore Combustion Chamber Cleaner

features.text: Engineered to optimize engine efficiency and power.
Penetrates and eliminates stubborn carbon deposits.

description: RESTORE™ - Combustion Chamber Cleaner is formulated to quickly dissolve heavy fuel deposits on injector tips, pistons and other combustion chamber surfaces in Gasoline Direct Inject (GDI) and other High-Output engines. Restore's powerful solvent blend can improve engine performance, reduce exhaust emissions and restore power. When used in conjunction with the EDR Fuel Service Machine, Restore will not harm oxygen sensors or catalytic converters when used as directed.
application: Refer to Instructions provided with MOC's EDR - 3 & ADVANCED Fuel System Service Machines.
